title: Porsche bulletin 1/99 - Turbo Rear Engine Mounts
notes: Bulletin dated 2000-01-20, group 1035. Restricted to Turbo S/X73 applicability. The body text gives bolt 900 082 118 09 as M12 x 1.5 x 125 and the nut 999 084 215 09 as M12 x 1.5; the parts table prints M12 x 1.2 x 125. Checked on 2026-11-05 against the level-A PET (Kat 017 page 230, illustration 401-00, position 22: M 12 X 1,5 X 125): the pitch is 1.5 and the table figure is a typographical error (CTR-0009, row AUDIT-014). The PET lists the number on the front-axle plate only, so it does not confirm the mount application.
